protocol.dependency: main_rill dev-only alias to package rill-spatial at ../../..; default SIMD features preserved
protocol.release_profile: This isolated workspace default release profile; matched across normal/fresh modes, not claimed identical to root benchmark thin-LTO profile
modes: same persistent index upserts + normal prepare at query phases
same persistent index upserts + discard/reconstruct from all current points + prepare at every query phase
protocol.rebuild_cost: Includes from_points allocation/construction and old-index destruction; both modes also pay identical upsert protocol even though fresh construction makes those prior updates redundant
protocol.timing_order: Mode and window order reversed on odd repetitions
protocol.oracle: Complete independent all-pairs membership proof, duplicate checks, same current inputs and arbitrary stable u64 IDs; every mode/window verified BEFORE any timings; no oracle inside measured runs
protocol.output: Reusable materialized Vec<u64> results; complete-vector black_box plus one opaque original-query-index/stable-ID operation per output ID
protocol.timed_intervals: Summed build/update/reconstruct/prepare/query/consume service intervals, not end-to-end wall latency; fixture parsing/current-authoritative-reference updates/oracle work excluded
protocol.initial_tree: Initial from_points does NOT prepare; initial tree construction is included in first query-phase prepare
protocol.identity: Bijective odd multiplication/xor remap of wire positions to arbitrary sparse u64 IDs; authoritative oracle maps IDs independently
protocol.scope: Six simulation frames and two 20k-query phases per trace; no root source modifications; no universal claims or main refit decision instrumentation
